messages:
DeployBot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PIN applied — runtime v2.16.3 pinned for model-group=llama3q. Reason: spike in decode_error_rate + prefix drop (4%→8%) in eu-central, us-west. Pin id pin-3190082468. Auto-unpin at +2h unless an owner clears. Details: runtime=2.16.3, sdk=3.2.1, affected variants: llama3q-16k-quant. Repro hint: short prompt + longcontext.

Carla: On it. Pulling logs from eu-central. @SRE-Oncall can you attach tracing for the failed decode calls?

Mike: Any immediate customer 5xxs? I see some increase in token errors but no user-facing 5xxs in the last 10m.

Ajay: quick check — SDK 3.2.1 has a default 'kv_serialization=true' change. Might be incompatible with runtime 2.16.3 kernel path for quantized models. I have a minimal repro, sending snippet.

Ajay: ```json
{ "model": "llama3q-16k-quant", "prompt": "<long prompt>...", "sdk_version": "3.2.1" }
// decode_error: mismatch in KV cache length
```

SRE-Oncall: Tagged tracing: https://traces.internal/r/3190082468 (redacted). We see increased attr 'kv_cache_resync' events correlated with latency spikes.

Ben: Ops note — we should pin routing to runtime 2.15.x for that model-group while we triage.

Carla: Agree. Proposal: keep pin for 2h, deploy a canary rollback to runtime 2.15.9 in us-west only, monitor decode_error_rate and latency.

Priya: Product note — if we keep pin, can we add a short release note: 'Mitigated decoding regressions for quantized llama3q variants by pinning runtime; investigating SDK interaction'

ProductLead: I'll write the blurb and send to comms. Also need engineering note for release notes explaining recommended SDK version rollback (3.1.x).

SupportBot: Notifying 'dedicated-customers' and 'partners' with a brief: 'We observed degradation for quantized llama3q models; temporary pin applied; no data loss; monitoring.'

Mike: For runbook — if decode_error_rate >5% after 1h on canary, then trigger rollback full (owner: Carla) and page SRE.

Carla: Ack. I'll kick off the canary rollback job now. Command: `deploybot rollback --model-group llama3q --from-runtime 2.16.3 --to-runtime 2.15.9 --regions us-west --canary 10%`

DeployBot: Command accepted. Canary rollout started. Job id job-3190082475. ETA: 8m. Will report progress in this thread.

Carla: :thumbsup: monitoring dashboards.

Ajay: Also preparing an SDK patch to revert kv_serialization default and add a compatibility flag. Will open PR and link here.

ProductLead: thx all — please add any logs or follow-ups to the ticket INF-5023

Carla: Adding postmortem note placeholder.

DeployBot: Update: canary rollout 10% success; decode_error_rate dropped from 8%→1.2% in canary. Keeping pin until 2h auto-unpin or manual clear. Job logs: https://jobs.internal/j/job-3190082475

Ben: Recommend schedule an emergency patch window tonight if rollback is needed beyond canary.

SRE-Oncall: I'll keep pages quiet unless threshold hits.

Carla: Will follow up with timeline for full rollback or SDK patch.

DeployBot: Pin expires at +2h (3190083668) unless cleared.

Carla: Closing the loop — leaving pin in place, monitoring, will escalate if anything regresses.
